generation.scope: On a quartic section with Neron-Severi lattice generated by the hyperplane and elliptic fiber, the two relative compactified Picard K3 surfaces are isomorphic. Under their twisted universal-sheaf equivalence the inverse four-twist product shifted by two becomes tensor by an ample square-four polarization, the sum of elliptic pencils meeting twice.

open_mathematics: Control the four shifted simple objects on the common twisted K3, and propagate the cohomology vanishing along its two pencils.
